presentation: recorded simulation poses rendered offline; same run for both cameras; no new planning execution during replay
execution: kinematic demonstration with Gazebo pose feedback; not contact/balance control
layout: following 1080p camera + fixed overhead 1080p camera + animated planning map and telemetry on 4K canvas

planning_overlays.green: current local wheel trajectory, keyed by generation simulation time
planning_overlays.footprints: planned landing positions, visible from climbing phase

timing.telemetry: 10 Hz recorded feedback, previous available sample displayed; local path generation stamps retained
timing.display_speed: body planar speed and yaw rate derived by central differences of recorded Gazebo poses; original executor v/w are wheel-command feedback only
